witness_family: Family of solid Moore/sphere modules M_i = S^0 / 2^i over the p-adic base for i \in N = {1, 2, 3, ...} at chromatic height n = 2.

deduction_steps.statement: Define M_i = S^0 / 2^i for i \in N. Each M_i is a finite p-torsion spectrum in Sp.
For each i, the chromatic localization L_2(M_i) is non-trivial and p-complete, with non-zero Morava E-homology E(2)_*(M_i).
The product P = \prod_{i=1}^\infty M_i is an uncountable product of finite spectra in SolidMod_{Z_p}.
deduction_steps.justification: Underlying condensed set has cardinality of the continuum with profinite topology.

deduction_steps.statement: By the Burklund-Hahn-Levy-Schlank (2023) theorem, L_2 does not preserve the product of mod p^i Moore spectra.
deduction_steps.justification: Failure of the telescope conjecture forces non-smashing of L_n, which prevents commutation with infinite products of torsion objects.

deduction_steps.statement: Specifically, the natural comparison morphism theta: L_n(prod M_i) -> prod L_n(M_i) has non-trivial homotopy fiber.
deduction_steps.justification: pi_0(fib(theta)) contains non-zero phantom elements that map to zero in each coordinate projection pi_j.
